scope: assistant direct inspection of all 16 actual deployed PNGs at 512x512; bounded pilot, no automatic scoring
method: Viewed each original decoded image, four conditions together for each fixed case/seed, and compared visible objects with the predeclared suite expectations. Copies are byte-identical. No blind evaluator or calibrated measurement.
findings: All eight vase-and-pears conditions fail a required object/count: seed 11760922 has one pear; seed 11760923 omits the vase.
Four geometry conditions at seed 11860922 preserve distinct cube/cone; the other four at 11860923 merge/distort the requested objects.
Failures occur in both base and adapter conditions; this does not establish that the adapter caused the baseline failures.
Adapter plain and trigger conditions both alter appearance; reliable trigger-specific learned control is not established.
No Diffusers parity or generalization claim. Technical matrix completion does not authorize candidate promotion.
